entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 225-aa sequence matches reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases at 73.9–74.7% identity over 96.9% query coverage (E-value 1.12e-114 to 2.14e-112).
Pfam Ham1p_like domain PF01725.22 detected at residues 7–218.
Strongly predicted to hydrolyze noncanonical purine triphosphates including dITP, ITP, and XTP to monophosphate plus diphosphate; exact substrate preferences remain inferred from homologs.

entities.name: B3DTK7 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed Bifidobacterium longum enzyme annotated as Mg2+-dependent nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66; prefers XTP, dITP, and ITP.
Annotated biological process includes purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism; cytosolic localization.
